title: A new image model and steadier text responses
summary:
A new image model and selectable HTML-generation model landed alongside text-stream fixes, community projects, and less imaginative feed counters.

Added the Azure-backed `gptimage` model for images up to 1024 pixels per side. Text changes improved DeepSeek v3 reasoning output and formatting for OpenAI-compatible streams. Grok support was added to the backend, then removed from the advertised model list.

The WebSim HTML generator now accepts a `model` query parameter, defaulting to `openai-large`, and its instructions favor single-file HTML. The MCP package also fixes an ES module error when launched with `npx`.

The project lists now include @James-Qi’s Emojiall AI Drawing Platform, which generates drawings in preset styles, and @Naman009’s MASala, which plans recipes from ingredients on hand.

highlights.title: Generate with gptimage
highlights.text: Create images with the new `gptimage` model, up to 1024 pixels per side. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gptimage).

highlights.title: Choose a WebSim model
highlights.text: The WebSim HTML generator now accepts a `model` query parameter, so you can choose which model generates your page. It defaults to `openai-large`.
